governance.attested_by: miso-42 keeper promotion, Wave-3 L-14 session 2026-07-06 (owner promotion decision 2026-07-06)
governance.note: miso-42 = the miso-41 keeper recipe (de-leaked neutral-1.0 gas bands + CT_PEAKER evening-window reliability floor + zonal/pergen reserve co-opt + priced interchange + seam limits + zonal gas basis + F923 per-plant coal pricing + historic CAMPD outage overlay) with ONE structural change: coal_econ_srmc_bound — the marginal (econ*/peak) coal tranches' fuel passthrough is clamped to >= 1.0 so no marginal coal offer sits below the plant's own measured F923 incremental delivered SRMC; the committed/must-run bands keep the contracted take-or-pay discount. This is a DOF REDUCTION: the gas-keyed passthrough sigmoid (the audit's largest weakly-identified fitted surface, C-1) no longer touches the tranches whose fuel is bought at market — its fitted asymptotes now reach only the committed band, where the take-or-pay contract story holds. The bound's value is the plant's own measured delivered cost (F923, rule-13 admissible: regenerates from any forward fuel trajectory), not a tuned number. It is an OFFER bound, not a floor: D-2 forced-energy attribution shows zero MWh from it (C8 PASS all years; legitimacy diagnostics Overall PASS). Promoted as strictly more structurally faithful (rule 1): a real cost floor restored, a fitted discount removed, nothing tuned to any residual — accepted at a known in-sample cost (coal 2023/24 under-run deepens, CC_REGULAR +2.9/+4.3 TWh worse) that the promotion explicitly does NOT hide; see exceptions.
governance.validation_note: Reproducible from the committed bundle: scripts/run_calibration_full.py --iso MISO --year 2023 2024 2025 --coal-bit-sigmoid --ct-intermediate-split --cc-intermediate-split --st-gas-intermediate --miso-zonal-gas-basis --cc-nameplate-summer-derate --priced-interchange --reference-price-interface --miso-firm-imports --miso-seam-flow-limit --miso-seam-export-limit --miso-pjm-border-anchor --energy-reserve-coopt --miso-zonal-reserves --miso-reserve-pergen --coal-econ-srmc-bound --out-dir results/calibration/MISO/miso_42_coal_econ_srmc (12 GB swap + MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=1 MARKET_SIM_HIGHS_THREADS=1; data/clean zonal-shares + capacity-deliverability partitions regenerated first per docs/multi-iso/miso-zonal-gate2.md). Leave-one-year-out (rule 22 in-sample clause): the change is a zero-free-parameter offer BOUND (no value fitted to any year), so LOO degenerates to per-year direction checks — confirmed in all three years independently: C3a improves (-9.8/-15.6/-19.5% -> -8.2/-13.0/-18.9%), the priced-out classes recover toward actuals (ST_GAS, CT_PEAKER, net imports), 2025 coal over-run improves (+8.8% -> +7.2%), CO2 PASS x3. Zero-forcing ablation twin registered alongside (2026-07-06-miso-42-coal-econ-ablation, rule 21). MISO's determination remains NOT-YET; the promotion is on strictly-more-grounded structure, not on caveats closing.

exceptions.classification: ACCEPTED MEASURED-INPUT LIMITATION (benchmark basis mismatch — not a model miss)
exceptions.reason: EIA-930 MISO reports NO pumped-storage series (verified: the PS column is all-null in every scored year of the balance files); the 0.245 TWh actual is battery-only, while the model side includes the 2,417 MW EIA-860 PS fleet (Ludington + Taum Sauk). The model's PS throughput sits INSIDE the eGRID net-energy-implied gross-discharge band (2.5-4.4 TWh depending on RTE basis) — the model is not over-cycling. No adder is admissible (PSH O&M < $1/MWh; the PJM $10 adder precedent in constants.py retired exactly this class of fit-to-mismeasured-target). Closable only in the scorer: compare battery-only model discharge vs NG: BAT when a BA reports battery-only (flagged to rubric infra). Full adjudication: results/calibration/FINDING-miso-c5b-storage-benchmark-2026-07.md.

exceptions.classification: ACCEPTED MEASURED-INPUT LIMITATION (same basis mismatch as C5b)
exceptions.reason: The monthly shape compares model BAT+PS discharge against the battery-only EIA-930 series; the PS seasonal arbitrage shape dominates the model side and is absent from the actual. Rides the C5b scorer fix. Secondary battery-side realism items (storage_vintage_ramp off — 660 of 802 MW are Mar-Nov 2025 CODs; cited degradation adder at 0) are deferred until the aligned BAT-vs-BAT comparison exists to score them (rule 13: cannot be validated against a basis-mismatched benchmark).

items.magnitude: +46.36 / +46.77 TWh (2023/24; was +44.35/+43.22 under miso-41 — the bound makes this row slightly WORSE and the promotion does not hide it)
items.reason: The rubric's canonical structural miss. Decomposition (results/calibration/FINDING-miso-cc-decomposition-2026-07.md): CC displaces under-modeled net imports (-23/-19 TWh vs actual) and the priced-out CT_PEAKER/ST_GAS/CHP classes (-33/-36 TWh), NOT coal and NOT wind (delivered-pinned); ~73% of the over-run is MISO-South; flat across the day; CC is not availability-bound (dispatch 78-81% of the 230 TWh availability integral). Magnitude-consistent with DP-1 (MIP crossbench: P1's no-min-load posture carries +34% committed CC energy; 135.6 x 1.34 = 181.7 ~= model). Closable only by the pooled commitment-posture build designed in docs/multi-iso/miso-scarcity-posture-design-2026-07.md — never by tuning CC offers to the TWh residual.

items.metric: C1 coal under-run (COAL_BIT -8.11 TWh 2023, COAL_PRB -9.91 TWh 2024) and gas peaker/steam under-run (CT_PEAKER -10.40, ST_GAS -10.12/-13.44 TWh)
items.magnitude: coal family 154.9/144.2 vs actual 175.0/167.1 TWh; CT/ST recover vs miso-41 but remain below actuals
items.classification: MODEL MISS (missing coal self-commitment volume; commitment posture)
items.reason: With marginal coal repriced to its true measured SRMC, the sigmoid discount is revealed to have been silently compensating for missing coal SELF-COMMITMENT volume (the SOM's perennial uneconomic-commitment finding): real coal units hold through low-price hours on commitment inertia the P1 LP does not carry, and the MISO fleet branch does not yet size the committed band from the measured EIA-923 Schedule-5 contract share (coal_takeorpay_from_data is not threaded in the plant-level MISO path). Rule-14 pattern: the accurate input stays; the revealed root cause is logged, not re-buried in the discount. Same commitment-posture family as the CC row.

items.metric: C3a system load-weighted mean LMP vs RT
items.classification: MODEL MISS (residual price-formation gap: commitment posture + RT premium)
items.reason: The SRMC bound closed the below-cost segment of the gap in every year. The remainder is (a) the commitment-posture wedge — a perfect-foresight P1 clears at the efficient frontier with no start/min-load rents, and (b) the RT-vs-hourly-LP premium (RT prices carry sub-hourly ramp scarcity a deterministic hourly LP cannot see; miso-scarcity-tail-diagnosis.md representation bound). Not closable by any further offer re-level without violating rule 13.

items.classification: MODEL MISS (same price-formation family as C3a/C3c)
items.reason: Shape misses concentrate in the scarcity-carrying months (winter events, summer heat waves) where the missing posture/scarcity rents sit; downstream of the same root causes.

items.classification: MODEL MISS (commitment posture + Midwest locational reserve; gate CLOSED-NEGATIVE per miso-39)
items.reason: docs/multi-iso/miso-scarcity-tail-diagnosis.md proved no admissible supply-side reserve structure reaches the shortage steps under perfect-foresight hourly dispatch (market-wide deliverable reserve >= 11 GW vs 4.4 GW requirement; South zonal always clearable at <= ~$23/MWh re-dispatch). The reachable DA-visible target is 1/24/38 h, via the pooled commitment-posture lever + data-gated Midwest reserve family designed in docs/multi-iso/miso-scarcity-posture-design-2026-07.md. 2023's all-RT single-hour transients are outside the hourly deterministic representation and are NOT a target (rule 13).
